profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Airbnb
profile.summary:
Programming Languages: Java, Ruby, Javascript, C#, Python, C/C++, SQL, HTML/CSS, PHP. 

Primarily server side software engineer with experience on the font end of the stack. I have an educational background in CS as well as professional experience as a software developer. Looking to continue gaining experience and developing my skills working in software/back-end development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Media Ingestion Team (June 2022 - current):
- Lead track introducing UGC video support and integrating three new product use cases, working with partner teams, determining requirements, managing timelines, leading two other engineers and owning delivery. Features: secured storage, signed token reads, server side validation, content check integration, dangling asset clean-up, multipart upload and testing environment setup. 
- Proposed and drove adoption of new media data model clearing up data ownership, increasing security with better permission control, consolidating duplicate logic and improving accessibility. Lead the migration of our biggest use case updating 300 million images to the new model before working with teammates to lead the remaining migrations
- Built out postcard generator to use when inviting co-travelers where we matched reservations to artwork, integrated with a third party to embed a localized, formatted destination in the artwork and transferred the final asset into our internal system to surface in the booking flow, leading to a 26% increase in inviting co-travelers and a 50% increase in co-travelers joining. 
- Drove team bug squashing initiatives by leading commitment to craft Fridays

Experiences Quality Team (August 2019 - June 2022):
- Lead five person cross team project to support last minute cancellation requests resulting in a 53% reduction in inbound cancellation cs tickets and an estimated annual savings of ~$97,000
- Own Experience review flow including leading all feature work, code migration from Rails monolith to Java services, new host reviews dashboard, maintenance migrations, and point person for all bugs and questions  
-Lead cross team initiative building in app flow for Experience hosts to get video trailers through uploading clips, being vetted, submitting to a third party api for editing and re-uploading into our platform onto their Experience page.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Server side engineer primarily working in Java and Rails microservices with some front-end work in Ember 
- Lead cross-team projects including integrating our product with the subscription platform to enforce active states as well as a migration of over 140,000 legacy accounts to a scalable, new model
- Took ownership of the product’s subscriptions and billing flow, fixing legacy code, adding new integrations and documenting that knowledge for the team
- Active in recruiting having conducted over 50 pair programming interviews

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Full-stack developer primarily working on Java microservices with front-end
work in Angular and React as well as databases in PostgreSQL and Mongo
- Built upon existing services as well as implemented new improvements to email marketing, contact management and communication services for customers
- Tested each new component by writing unit and integration tests as well as verifying new code through all testing environments

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Server-side software engineer primarily using C#, Python and SQL
- Designed and implemented new mechanisms as well as improved on existing ones for detecting invalid traffic in online advertising
- Built new and maintained existing server side code for processing over two billion requests per day
- Wrote and executed unit tests for verifying all personal components added to our systems
- Other technologies: Vertica, MySQL, SVN, Splunk, Puppet

positions.title: Junior Developer / Q/A Analyst
positions.description:
- Built out responsive websites, emails and banners in HTML, CSS, Javascript, PHP and Flash for new pharmaceutical campaigns based on design files
- Updated websites, iPad apps (HTML/CSS/jQuery embedded in the iRep framework) and interactive visual aids in Flash 
- Executed black box testing on all internally developed projects 
- Created automated test cases using Selenium Web Drivers written in Java

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
- Performed black box testing on the front-end software releases for all of the corporate perks sites and internal sites
- Worked closely with developers to debug and fix issues that emerged on staging
- Executed patch, full and emergency releases to update our website with the most accurate and highest quality code
- Checked and proof-read all marketing e-mails for accuracy of content

positions.title: Temp - Sales and Business Development
positions.description:
- Updated the corporate perks website daily with new content and a redesigned layout to optimize marketing and maximize sales
- Researched market performance weekly and designed new sales offers to optimize customer satisfaction and revenue based on those performance revues
- Provided guidance to the engineering team on how to resolve the website's technical issues

positions.title: Librarian at the Screen Arts and Culture's Donald Hall Collection
positions.description:
- Helped students and faculty find films and screenplays to check out by using the library system catalogue to locate and pull items off the shelf
- Operated the online library system to check materials in and out, manage the library contents, extend due dates and circulate materials through the university library system
- Opened, ran and closed the library individually in the absence of the head librarian
- Translated foreign film titles, verified attainability of foreign titles and acquired new foreign films in order to further broaden the spectrum of the library

positions.title: Duderstadt Film Studio Stagehand
positions.description:
- Operated the camera while working with a team of students and professionals mixing live footage from multiple cameras to obtain high quality recordings of live performances
- Constructed sets, lighting designs, audience seating and set up cameras before every performance recording session and disassembled the equipment after the performance
- Trained on the operation and programming of the lighting board and sound board based off of different staging and microphone formations

positions.title: Musical Director
positions.description:
- Devised a schedule to teach the 15 person ensemble a repertoire of 12 songs through the course of each semester
- Maximizing two rehearsals of two hours each week, I lead the group in warm ups, taught individual parts to singers, worked on vocal technique, fixed balance issues, improved blend and polished repertoire
- Recorded vocal arrangements in individual parts. Edited and mixed tracks for balance using ProTools for upcoming CDs
- Facilitated discussions within the group on ideas for improvement, where individuals felt insecure in our performances and how best to structure rehearsals to achieve the best progress and success
- Organized song selection for weekly performances in order to have a strong song order, to take into account absent singers and parts and to give all of our songs equal performance opportunity
- Ran supplemental rehearsals for the lower voices, for the higher voices and for individuals who needed extra help
- Created and taught the group choreography, drilled music and organized external feedback for a twelve minute set in preparation for and competition in the International Championship of Collegiate A cappella

company.name: University of Michigan Dicks and Janes A Cappella

positions.title: Musical Director for Kiss Me, Kate!
positions.description:
- Lead 5 four-hour musical rehearsals a week, teaching the actors the extensive vocal score, working on vocal technique and perfecting balance between parts
- Restructured on a weekly basis the optimal schedule to teach, stage and rehearse the entire show throughout the 12 week rehearsal processes
- Devised and lead the optimal music audition and callback to show the director, choreographer and myself the best actor to cast for each role
- Gave notes for improvement to the actors after every rehearsal, dress-rehearsal and performance in order to further improve the quality of the show

positions.title: Accompanist
positions.description:
- Accompanied on the piano the five week rehearsal processes and two week performance run of a musical theatre production of Sweet Charity
- Lead music rehearsals once a week teaching the performers their vocal parts and working on singing technique
- Assembled and put away the instruments, music stands and chairs before and after each rehearsal and performance

positions.title: Accompanist
positions.description:
- Lead a beginning voice class of 20 students in vocal warm-ups at the beginning of every class
- Accompanied all performances by the teacher and the students throughout the duration of the course
- Worked with students outside of class as a vocal coach to practice for in-class performances and to help them improve their singing technique
